title: Python
description: Python projects: a current Python with pip and uv mounted in; PyPI and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Python
de.description: Python-Projekte: ein aktuelles Python mit pip und uv eingehängt; PyPI und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: Python (3.14, with pip and uv) comes with the preset (--toolchain python): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox); it comes before the image's own python3. Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add python: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.

The interpreter is marked externally managed: install into a virtual environment (uv venv, python3 -m venv .venv). uv fetches another Python version it is asked for from GitHub (python-build-standalone) into the sandbox's HOME.
Data and machine learning (Hugging Face, more memory, a GPU): the preset data-ml.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
